description: Set Marvin's live Discord presence (status + activity text) so Ian and other bots (e.g. Amos) can read what state a session is in without guessing — relay.py polls this and calls change_presence().

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Update Marvin's Discord presence. 'online' is the default resting state (short tasks don't need to call this at all). 'idle' is for a long autonomous session posting periodic checkpoints — pair it with an activity string summarizing the current step. 'dnd' is for going dark on uninterrupted work — pair it with an activity string stating the task and rough ETA. Call again with state=online and no activity when the work finishes to clear it.

activity.description: Short free-text status line shown next to the presence dot (e.g. 'heads-down: presence refactor, back ~30m'). Omit or pass empty string to clear.
